create_mturk_requester: create a new MTurkRequester instance using MTurkRequester.new with a MephistoDB and requester name
register_mturk_requester: register an MTurkRequester with AWS IAM access key ID and secret access key credentials
check_mturk_registration: check if an MTurkRequester is registered by calling is_registered to verify AWS credentials
get_mturk_budget: get the available MTurk requester budget balance by calling get_available_budget on the requester
create_mturk_qualification: create a new MTurk qualification owned by the requester using _create_new_mturk_qualification with a name
